frozen_plan.amendment: A3 (supervisor review): restore RD4 Arm C max_error_deg to its original frozen 1e-6 deg and instead replace the ill-conditioned trace/arccos angular evaluation with the mathematically equivalent relative-quaternion 2*atan2(||vec||,|w|) geodesic distance. The decision boundary is unchanged; only the arithmetic used to evaluate it changed. Verified in verify_rotation_distance.py: identical orientations 1.46e-14 deg (bit-identical inputs exactly 0), q/-q invariant, rotations at 0.5x/0.99x/1.01x/2.0x the unchanged 1e-6 deg boundary all classified correctly with recovered angle accurate to 2e-8 relative, agreement with the superseded formulation to 3.5e-12 relative where that formulation is well conditioned. The superseded formulation has a 2.70e-6 deg floor on identical orientations, above the boundary for 5.6 percent of random orientations, which is why it was replaced. Run 3 and the pre-amendment harness are preserved under failed_runs/ and harness_snapshots/pre_A3_run3/.
